trial_court: XIV Additional District Judge, Krishna, F.C.O.P. No.634 of 2017
case_name: Nerella Chiranjeevi Arun Kumar vs Nerella Akulasowjanya
facts_of_case: Petitioner sought to set aside dismissal order and restore main petition; G.P.A. holder wants to contest proceedings.

legal_principles.principle: The Court cannot throw out the evidence of a power of attorney on behalf of the principal, which has to be tested on the same lines as any witness subject to the principles under the law of evidence.
legal_principles.held: In a given case, if the statement of a power of attorney cannot be relied on as not being a direct evidence, necessary presumption can always be drawn against the party for not coming before the Court.
cited_cases: T.C.Mathai v. District and Sessions Judge, Thiruvananthapuram (2003) SCJ Online (AP) 1040

legal_principles.principle: A power of attorney is an authority whereby one is set in the turn, stead, or place of another to act for him.
legal_principles.held: In Stroud's 'Judicial Dictionary', power of attorney is described as 'an authority whereby one is set in the turn, stead, or place of another to act for him.'
cited_cases: T.C.Mathai v. District and Sessions Judge, Thiruvananthapuram (2003) SCJ Online (AP) 1040

legal_principles.principle: A recognized agent or pleader can make and do appearances, applications and acts on behalf of a party in litigation.
legal_principles.held: Rule 1 of Order III contemplates that any appearance, application or act in or to any Court required or authorized by law to be made or done by a party may, except where otherwise expressly provided by any law for the time being in force, be made or done by the party in person, or by his recognized agent, or by a pleader appearing, applying or acting, as the case may be, on his behalf.
cited_cases: Tukaram, through G.P.A. Holder v. Bheem Rao and others (1999) SCJOnline(SC) 1305

outcome.final_order: Allowed the application filed by the petitioner under Order 9 Rule 9 C.P.C. to set aside the dismissal order and to restore the main petition, directing the petitioner to appear in person for reconciliation.

use_for_drafting: advising on representation in family court
